blurb: 192 Brewing Company brews a variety of beers including pale ales, wheat, rye, stout, and IPA styles. Their Lake Trail Taproom in Kenmore offers up to 14 beers and ciders on tap, local wines, and craft spirits. The taproom is family and dog friendly and serves fresh food with vegetarian options.
